# Assets · Status

14 files under `assets/Status/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for active.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Alert lifecycle icons — active, pending, work in progress, progress alert, overdue, implemented, closed, auto-closed, rejected, generated — plus energy / environment categories and the view-arrow action. Multi-ink; always pair with the status word.
